description: On the table in front of you there’s a dark cup on the right, a toothbrush inside it, and a small toothpaste tube lying near the center. The right hand reaches to the cup, grasps the toothbrush as a right-hand object and lifts it out while the left hand picks up the toothpaste tube as a left-hand object; the left hand brings the tube’s nozzle over the toothbrush bristles and squeezes to dispense toothpaste, then the right hand moves the toothbrush back and lowers it into the cup and releases it.
